trust_root_resolution: Verifier MUST be invoked in TEST mode with --trust-root pointing to input/trust-root.json. Production-mode verifier MUST reject this fixture's test-key signature even though the signature is cryptographically valid; key_id begins with 'keel-test-' to enable that rejection.
error_precedence_note: Not applicable — this is a happy-path PASS case. Any FAIL outcome from a conforming verifier indicates a non-conformance somewhere in the verifier's pipeline.
failure_isolation_note: All verification layers are deliberately valid by design. This is the baseline against which all tampered vectors are constructed; each tampered vector starts from a fixture identical to this one and applies exactly one mutation.
notes: Baseline happy path. The simplest case that exercises the full verification pipeline: parse, schema-validate, manifest signature verify, chain walk, closure binding check. A verifier that fails this in TEST mode (with the correct --trust-root) is non-conforming at conformance Level 1.
